anchors.evidence: Figure 2 left and right outer panels
anchors.observation: Two phases occupy unequal widths, with the expansion phase much wider.
anchors.decision: Use a narrow construction panel and a broad operator field.

anchors.observation: Small pastel circular nodes carry the visual argument; edges connect nodes directly.
anchors.decision: Use editable colored circles and native lines as the main marks.

anchors.observation: Textbook hierarchy is shown as vertical branching, then horizontal relations appear between peers.
anchors.decision: Distinguish tree edges and inferred horizontal edges in the initial graph.

anchors.observation: Operators are numbered and distributed across graph transformations, not serialized as six equal boxes.
anchors.decision: Arrange numbered operator vignettes in two rows with no repeated processing boxes.

anchors.observation: Green catalog, pale yellow entity, peach core, blue non-core and pink duplicate cues are used.
anchors.decision: Retain a reduced version of the same categorical palette.

anchors.observation: Dashed circles and routes signal candidate matching and inferred connections.
anchors.decision: Use dashed candidate/iteration cues, and label their meaning.

anchors.observation: Thin black lines, serif labels, sparse tan transformation arrows and white background.
anchors.decision: Use fine dark strokes, white space and light tan transformation arrows with larger presentation text.
